reviews.t: I rarely share my opinion but I can tell you that this is the BEST bakery in the area. My favorite is its delicious Pain au Chocolat that I took every morning during my stay in Paris at the Novotel next to it.

Client habituel de cette boulangerie. Le service, les prestations et les produits sont excellents.
Pains, viennoiseries et gâteaux toujours frais et personnel toujours souriant, je recommande à 100%.
Very friendly young woman and tasty mini pain au chocolat. Highly recommended 👍
